basic_details.job_title: Thrissur District Court Senior Clerk Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One temporary Senior Clerk post at the Family Court, Kunnamkulam in Thrissur district is open only to persons who have retired from equivalent or higher posts in courts and have not completed 62 years of age. The District Court, Thrissur (ജില്ലാ കോടതി, തൃശ്ശൂർ) offers the post on contract under the Civil Judiciary department, for a continuous 179 days or until the appointee completes 62 years of age, whichever comes first, at a salary of ₹23,360/-. Bio-data with documents must reach the District Judge directly or by post before 5 PM on 3 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Applications are made offline, either by hand or by post. The notice prescribes no application form. Applicants send their complete bio-data with supporting documents.
Prepare a complete bio-data that includes your mobile number.
Enclose a copy of your Aadhaar card.
Enclose attested copies of the certificates that prove your age, qualification and work experience.
Address the application to: District Judge, District Court Complex, Ayyanthole, Thrissur - 680 003.
Submit it directly or send it by post so that it is received before 5 PM on 3 December 2026.
Attested copies of certificates proving age
Attested copies of certificates proving qualification
Attested copies of certificates proving work experience
important_instructions: A mobile number in the application is mandatory. Applications must reach the District Judge before 5 PM on 3 December 2026; the deadline is for receipt, not for posting.

content_sections.heading: About Thrissur District Court Senior Clerk
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the District Court, Thrissur and signed by the District Judge (In-charge). The District Court functions from the District Court Complex, Ayyanthole, Thrissur - 680 003, and the vacancy is in the Family Court at Kunnamkulam in Thrissur district. For enquiries, the notice prints the phone number 0487 - 2360248 and the email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The Senior Clerk post is meant for retired court employees. The notice lists two conditions: Applicants must have retired from equivalent or higher posts in courts. Applicants must not have completed 62 years of age. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The notice prints no date as on which age is counted. Applicants must, however, send certificates proving their age, qualification and work experience. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice prints the salary of the Senior Clerk post as ₹ 23,360/-. It does not mention any allowance. The post is temporary, and the engagement is on contract basis. The appointment runs for a continuous 179 days or until the appointed person completes 62 years of age, whichever comes first.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Thrissur District Court Senior Clerk
content_sections.text: Applications are made offline, either by hand or by post. The notice prescribes no application form. Applicants send their complete bio-data with supporting documents. Prepare a complete bio-data that includes your mobile number. Enclose a copy of your Aadhaar card. Enclose attested copies of the certificates that prove your age, qualification and work experience. Address the application to: District Judge, District Court Complex, Ayyanthole, Thrissur - 680 003. Submit it directly or send it by post so that it is received before 5 PM on 3 December 2026. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The appointment is made in rank order from a list prepared for the post. The list is based on a detailed scrutiny of the applications, the candidates' qualifications and an interview. The notice does not give the interview date or venue.
